newsitem.title: USA: Cambridge Heart CFO Hennessey resigning.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Heart CFO Hennessey resigning.

text.p: Cambridge Heart Inc said Monday that Thomas Hennessey, its vice president and chief financial officer, is leaving the company.
Cambridge made the announcement in a press release. It did not say why Hennessey was leaving. Cambridge officials were not available for comment.
The company said Joseph Laycox, formerly materials manager, will assume Hennessey's manufacturing responsibilities. It said it was searching for a new CFO.
Cambridge today reported a net loss in the second quarter of $0.16 per share, versus a $0.12-per-share proforma net loss in the same period a year earlier.
